summary: @onereach/si-text-message preinstall fetches Bun runtime to execute an undeclared obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/ into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against math_init.js — a 727KB heavily obfuscated string-array bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs` header, WV8StW rotator over a ~2500-entry char-code/token dictionary `n7gIxM`) shipped at the tarball root. Both setup.mjs and math_init.js sit outside the package's declared `files: ["lib/*"]` manifest and have no relationship to the advertised Vue text-message input component. Using the Bun runtime specifically to execute the obfuscated sibling bypasses Node-based static analysis of the installed code path. Installing the package runs the obfuscated payload on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
